llm_response.reason: The website mixes online gambling promises with spoofed e-commerce categories resembling legitimate brands like Lazada, aggressively advertises impossible jackpots and 'guaranteed payouts,' uses urgency-inducing language, and obscures links with URL shorteners. The site was registered very recently with privacy shielding and lacks appropriate business contact details, payment transparency, or real company information. These are all classic signs of a scam website, most closely fitting the 'Fake Online Shopping' category by leveraging spoofed retail layouts to lure victims.
